description: Use this when a human must publish the DNS records for a custom domain. Requires auth. Inputs: domain_id (required; the dom_… id from cooper_add_domain or cooper_list_domains), expires_in_hours (optional integer from 1 to 168, default 72). Returns {url, expires_at, domain_id, hostname}. url is one page the human opens. It shows the records, a zone file, and Check now. It is not an API key. Creating a link revokes the previous link for that domain. A verified domain can still have a link. Another account's id is domain_not_found. Failure codes: unauthorized, domain_not_found, invalid_body, permission_denied.

domain_id.description: Domain id (dom_…) from cooper_add_domain or cooper_list_domains

expires_in_hours.description: Hours until the link stops working. Integer from 1 to 168. Default 72.

name: cooper_domain_setup_link

outputSchema.description: A link the human opens to publish DNS for one domain.

domain_id.description: Domain id (dom_…) this link is for.

expires_at.description: ISO-8601 time the link stops working.

hostname.description: Hostname shown on the setup page.

url.description: Page for this domain's DNS records. Send it to the human. It is not an API key.

title: Create a domain setup link
